_comment: Hand edits on top of the OpenStreetMap draft of Herrljunga C (scripts/stations/draft_from_osm.py), BUILDOUT O5 batch 1 (2026-10-29). Drafted from OSM only so far; facts from the operator's station page, photos or a walk go here with their source. Level names are placeholders until a plan or signage names them.

sources.note: Laserdata Nedladdning, skog, © Lantmäteriet, bearbetad, CC BY 4.0: building and roof heights and the ground (3D research pass; pack in data/stations/research/740000040).
JNB 2027 Bilaga 2A and BanInfo Plattform: platform height classes (3D research pass; data/stations/research/trafikverket_platforms_SE.csv).

changelog.what: First draft from OSM (BUILDOUT O5 batch 1).
Platform heights from Trafikverket's register; 15 buildings, roofs and footbridges with laser heights; the ground as a 5 m grid (3D research pass, data/stations/research/740000040).

platform_refs_source.r7167590: Trafikverket BanInfo (CC0) platform objects BIS 2477, 2478 run alongside osm:way/r7167590; tracks 6, 7 from the register (JNB 2027 Bilaga 2A) run alongside osm:way/r7167590, read 2026-10-30 (data/stations/research/740000040); BanInfo's track numbers were being re-issued then: check on site
platform_refs_source.r7167591: Trafikverket BanInfo (CC0) platform objects BIS 1458 run alongside osm:way/r7167591; tracks 1, 2, 3 from the register (JNB 2027 Bilaga 2A) run alongside osm:way/r7167591, read 2026-10-30 (data/stations/research/740000040); BanInfo's track numbers were being re-issued then: check on site

1–3._source: Trafikverket register (CC0), Bilaga 2A tab 4 row 301; BanInfo BIS 1458 (track 1): tracks 2,3,1, class mellan = 0.58 m above rail, 270 m long; a recorded design class, not a survey

6–7._source: Trafikverket register (CC0), Bilaga 2A tab 4 row 298; BanInfo BIS 2477 (track 6): tracks 6, class mellan = 0.58 m above rail, 250 m long; a recorded design class, not a survey
